name: Connector to Interposer Workflow
description: Validate workbook connectivity and reconcile approved connector artifacts in a project copy
description_full: Native KiCad workflow for authoritative workbook import, RF/DC netclass classification, source-row inspection, copper-layer permissions, independent RF gang and multi-pin DC connector placement, approved read-only connector, interposer, mounting-hole and symbol selection from loaded KiCad libraries, optional project-wide RF transition reconciliation, DXF circle anchors, optional managed board outlines, deterministic schematic and BOM generation, reviewed reconciliation and journal recovery. Isolated native analysis discovers and validates the matching bundled KiCad Python runtime on Windows, Linux and AppImage installations. Applies to a separate controlled project copy. RF locations use individual signal-plus-shield parts; DC connectors use one selected single-unit multi-pin symbol and footprint with explicit NC handling. Footprint and RF transition authoring remain separate librarian tools. Multi-unit DC symbols, live-editor recovery, generic magnetic picking and fabrication/EM qualification are outside the validated scope.
